entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for opposite party no.2 as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The present application has been moved seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No. 1792 of 2023,
under Sections 420, 406, 467, 468, 471, 120-B I.P.C., Police Station- Indirapuram, District- Ghaziabad with the prayer that in the event of arrest, applicant may be released on bail.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and he has an apprehension that he may be arrested in the above-mentioned case, inspite of the fact that there is no credible evidence against him, yet the investigation officer submitted the charge in per-functionary manner without any cogent evidence against him.

He further submits that the Shalini Khanna vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132491704/
1 applicant has no criminal antecedents and the applicant undertakes to co-operate during the trial and he would appear as and when required by the investigating agency or Court.

entities.text: Shalini Khanna vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It has been stated that in case, the applicant is granted anticipatory bail, he shall not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate with the investigation and would obey all conditions of bail.

4. Learned A.G.A.opposed the anticipatory bail and argued that credible evidence has been collected during the investigation, which has culminated in submission of charge sheet.
5.

In the case of Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra, (2011) 1 SCC 694, it has been held by the Hon'ble Supreme Court that while deciding anticipatory bail, Court must consider nature and gravity of accusation, antecedent of accused, possibility of accused to flee from justice and that Court must evaluate entire available material against the accused carefully and that the exact role of the accused has also to be taken into consideration.

entities.text: Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra, (2011) 1 SCC 694
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
6. In the instant case, considering the settled principle of law regarding anticipatory bail,
submissions of the learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusation, role of applicant and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merit of the case,
no case for anticipatory bail is made out.
7. The anticipatory bail application is rejected.

Order Date :- 10.7.2025 AS  Shalini Khanna vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132491704/
